usage.source_scope: Eight PB1/PB2-A-disjoint Hong Kong public entities, split four Development and four test, with one human-audited identity-bearing and one context query per entity.
usage.project_application: Supply positive named-place authority before any retained functional portal is allowed to bind or guide approach.
usage.modifications: Retain OCR as an independent high-precision witness rather than the sole route. Missing text is UNKNOWN and preserves the appearance decision; a unique alias proof can authorize its entity and veto other requested entities.
usage.expected_effect: Preserve target-present acceptance while reducing appearance-driven wrong-place confirmations.

evaluation.setup: Source-only audit froze eight new entities before any PB3 OCR or embedding call. Development alone selected DINOv2 appearance acceptance and lexical score/margin thresholds; test remained sealed. RapidOCR used frozen PP-OCRv6 models, and appearance ran on measured-faster verified RTX 5060 CUDA.
evaluation.effect: On eight test queries, alias proof was correct on 5/5 emitted proofs and the asymmetric join preserved 8/8 positive acceptance while reducing source-label-negative false confirmations from 23/24 to 9/24. The frozen identity-bearing coverage gate failed at 2/4 versus the required 3/4. A fixed target-blind tiling diagnostic added zero proofs.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Fresh confirmation of a conditional public metadata-plus-text mechanism, but a failed promotion gate because identity-bearing coverage was insufficient. Cross-paired negatives are source-label proxies, and curated identity-bearing views are not prevalence. No portal, active-view, navigation, arrival, product, user, or safety claim follows.

evidence.summary: Frozen source isolation, arms, Development-only selection, metrics, gate, and successor.
Durable PB3 metrics, decision, diagnostic, evidence hashes, and claim boundary.
Development/test appearance, text, asymmetric join, raw records, backend, and gate clauses.
Consumed-cohort fixed target-blind tiling diagnostic with no coverage gain.

history.change: Ran PB3 once; retained the asymmetric high-precision mechanism signal but rejected branch promotion because source-labeled identity-bearing coverage missed its frozen gate.
